mechanism: Ingests option quotes (CSV or native MT5 SYMBOL_OPTION_* / SYMBOL_PRICE_VOLATILITY), inverts mid to IV via hybrid Newton–Raphson/bisection Black-Scholes, builds strike×expiry grid with nearest-neighbour gap fill, renders 3D surface so skew (across strikes) and term structure (across expiries) are readable as height/colour.

mechanism: Encode rolling window of log returns as Bandt–Pompe ordinal patterns (Lehmer index, d=3..7), build directed transition counts, compare forward vs time-reversed pattern histograms via Jensen–Shannon divergence → irreversibility in [0,1]. High = directional/trending drive; near 0 = time-symmetric range/noise. Defaults d=3, 90-bar returns on EURUSD M30 after sweep.
data_needed: Price or 1-bar log-return window ≥ MinBars=10·d!+(d−1); embedding d; regime threshold (default 0.03)
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M30 primary sweep; synthetic noise/trend/sawtooth oracles; transferable via OrdinalNetworkSweep to other symbols/TFs
why_new_for_mis: Shape-only, scale-free trend-vs-range regime metric from ordinal dynamics—orthogonal to ATR/MA slope sensors.
quote: A ranging or mean-reverting market has no preferred direction of time, so its shape statistics are near-symmetric and irreversibility sits near zero. A market with a persistent directional drive breaks that symmetry, and irreversibility rises.

mechanism: Normalized permutation entropy PE=H(pattern hist)/ln(d!) of ordinal distribution; on near-efficient FX raw PE hugs ~1, so indicator plots causal rolling percentile rank of PE vs prior lookback—dip toward 0 flags unusually structured (inefficient) windows. Forbidden-fraction kept in engine but flat at short FX windows.
data_needed: Same ordinal window as irreversibility; InpPctLookback (default 250) of past PE values
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M30; efficiency panel separate from regime panel
why_new_for_mis: Rolling-normalized ordinal efficiency collapse is a structure-emergence sensor usable when raw entropy is ceiling-stuck.
quote: A dip in the percentile line toward zero is the actionable event: it says the market has just become unusually structured relative to its recent self

mechanism: CVolatilityEstimators ring buffer implements Close-to-Close, Parkinson (HL), Garman-Klass (OHLC), and Yang-Zhang = σ_overnight² + k·σ_oc² + (1−k)·σ_RS² with Rogers–Satchell intrabar term and k=0.34/(1.34+(N+1)/(N−1)). YZ reacts on gap bars; multiplicative bands center·exp(±mult·σ). Prefer YZ on session-gapping markets, GK on near-continuous FX.
data_needed: OHLC bars + lagged close; window N (default 20); optional barsPerYear for annualization
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Stocks/indices/futures with gaps; intraday FX/near-continuous; VolatilityBands vs Bollinger demo

quote: Use Yang-Zhang on anything with real session breaks (stocks, indices, futures, and forex across the weekend), because it is the only one of the four that measures the overnight gap directly.
